sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def parse(frame):
    seg=frame.segmentation; nodes=seg['nodes']
    bg=max(nodes,key=lambda n:n['pixels'])
    blocks={}
    for n in nodes:
        if n['id']==bg['id'] or n['pixels']!=4: continue
        rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        blocks[(min(rs),min(cs))]=n['color']
    return blocks
before = parse(current_frame)
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':26,'col':14}])
after = parse(current_frame)
# print the 6 lines before/after
def lines(b):
    def line(r,cols): return [b.get((r,c)) for c in cols]
    def vline(c,rs): return [b.get((r,c)) for r in rs]
    cols5=[23,26,29,32,35]; cols10=[17,20,23,26,29,32,35,38,41,44]; rs=[20,23,29,32,38,41,44]
    return dict(A=line(17,cols5),B=line(26,cols10),C=line(35,cols10),D=line(44,cols5),L=vline(23,rs),M=vline(35,rs))
print("BEFORE", lines(before))
print("AFTER ", lines(after))
print({k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def parse(frame):
    seg=frame.segmentation; nodes=seg['nodes']
    bg=max(nodes,key=lambda n:n['pixels'])
    blocks={}
    for n in nodes:
        if n['id']==bg['id'] or n['pixels']!=4: continue
        rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        blocks[(min(rs),min(cs))]=n['color']
    return blocks
